facts.fact: Hattie 在药柜里找 risperidone 药瓶，但药早已不在，她翻找后仍没找到。
Hattie 坐在合上的马桶盖上双手掩面；她承认自己确实看到了海鸥的幻象。
facts.anchor: Hattie sits on the closed toilet seat and puts her face in her hands.

facts.fact: Julian 其实只是在拨弄一只死鸟，Hattie 却对他发作、把他吓坏了。
facts.anchor: In reality Julian had been poking at a dead bird.

facts.fact: 回忆：Ed 葬礼后几天，一辆警车停在他们家外，以防 Tommy 回家。
facts.anchor: It was a few days after Ed’s funeral while a police cruiser was still stationed outside their house

facts.fact: Hattie 吃了微波炉加热的千层面，并看了当天送到的人寿保险文件。
facts.anchor: Hattie ate a small piece of lasagna warmed in the microwave

facts.fact: Ed 几年前瞒着她给自己加保了一份额外寿险，数额大得惊人。
facts.anchor: It seemed Ed had taken out an extra policy on himself a few years ago without her knowing.

facts.fact: 记忆中她跪在浴缸边，双手掐住四岁的 Tommy 的脖子把他按进水里。
facts.anchor: Then she was kneeling by the bathtub, hands reaching and wrapping around Tommy’s thin throat.

facts.fact: 窗外有翅膀的影子一闪而过——是猫头鹰又在监视她。
facts.anchor: The owl, of course. Watching again.
